name: FIBO Generate 1.5
description: FIBO Generate creates images from a text prompt, a reference image, or both. Each result includes the seed and the structured JSON (VGL) prompt used to render it; send them back to recreate the image exactly or to refine it with a new prompt. Outputs are 1MP or 4MP in nine aspect ratios.

prompt.description: Text prompt. Use alone, with `images` as a reference, or with `structured_prompt` to refine a previous result.

images.description: One reference image: a public URL or base64-encoded image data (a `data:` URI prefix is accepted).

structured_prompt.description: Structured (VGL) prompt as a JSON string, as returned by a previous result. Recreates that image with the same `seed`; add `prompt` to refine it. Cannot be combined with `images`.

resolution.description: Output resolution. 4MP adds about 30 seconds of latency. Default 1MP.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results. Pass the seed of a previous result with its `structured_prompt` to recreate or refine it.

ip_signal.description: When true, the result carries a `warning` if the text input may reference IP-protected content. Default false.

prompt_content_moderation.description: Reject the request if the prompt fails content moderation. Default true.

visual_input_content_moderation.description: Reject the request if the reference image fails content moderation. Default true.

visual_output_content_moderation.description: Fail the request if the generated image fails content moderation. Default true.

image.description: URL of the generated image. Bria hosts it for a limited time (3 days by default); download it to keep it.

structured_prompt.description: Structured (VGL) prompt used for this image, as a JSON string. Pass it back with `seed` to recreate or refine the image.

warning.description: Present when `ip_signal` flagged the prompt as possibly IP-protected.
